author: Trotsky, Leon
title: How the Revolution Armed: The Military Writings and Speeches of Leon Trotsky, Volume I: 1918
publisher: New Park Publications, London (trans. Brian Pearce)
notes: Trotsky's own orders, decrees, speeches and reports as Commissar for Military and Naval Affairs, first published in Russian by the Soviet state in 1923 and translated by Brian Pearce. Read in full on the Marxists Internet Archive, whose text carries no printed pagination - citations therefore name the piece and its date rather than a page. A primary source and a partisan one twice over: it is the record of what the man in charge said at the time, published later by a state he was arguing with.
